crossRefs.note: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”

translations.web: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”
translations.bsb: So they said, “We will call the girl and ask her opinion.”
translations.kjv: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.
translations.asv: And they said, We will call the damsel, and inquire at her mouth.
